lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: onee chalan sadaa nihaaliaa har kharach leeaa pat paai ||
lines.translation: They keep death constantly before their eyes; they gather the Provisions of the Lord's Name, and receive honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh daragah ma(n)neeahi har aap lae gal laai ||2||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. The Lord Himself takes them in His Loving Embrace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhaa no pa(n)th paragataa dar thaak na koee paai ||
lines.translation: For the Gurmukhs, the Way is obvious. At the Lord's Door, they face no obstructions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam salaahan naam man naam rahan liv laai ||
lines.translation: They praise the Lord's Name, they keep the Naam in their minds, and they remain attached to the Love of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਦਰਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anahad dhunee dar vajade dar sachai sobhaa paai ||3||
lines.translation: The Unstruck Celestial Music vibrates for them at the Lord's Door, and they are honored at the True Door. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee guramukh naam salaahiaa tinaa sabh ko kahai saabaas ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who praise the Naam are applauded by everyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat dehi prabh mai jaachik kee aradaas ||
lines.translation: Grant me their company, God-I am a beggar; this is my prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੩੧॥੬॥੭੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaag vade tinaa guramukhaa jin a(n)tar naam paragaas ||4||33||31||6||70||
lines.translation: O Nanak, great is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who are filled with the Light of the Naam within. ||4||33||31||6||70||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa too rataa dekh kai putr kalatr seegaar ||
lines.translation: Why are you so thrilled by the sight of your son and your beautifully decorated wife?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ras bhogahi khuseeaa karahi maanahi ra(n)g apaar ||
lines.translation: You enjoy tasty delicacies, you have lots of fun, and you indulge in endless pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸੀ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut karahi phuramaaisee varatahi hoi aphaar ||
lines.translation: You give all sorts of commands, and you act so superior.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: karataa chit na aavaee manamukh a(n)dh gavaar ||1||
lines.translation: The Creator does not come into the mind of the blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukh. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man sukhadaataa har soi ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the Lord is the Giver of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai karam paraapat hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, He is found. By His Mercy, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਪੜਿ ਭੋਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kapaR bhog lapataaiaa suinaa rupaa khaak ||
lines.translation: People are entangled in the enjoyment of fine clothes, but gold and silver are only dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੇ ਕੀਏ ਰਥ ਅਥਾਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: haivar gaivar bahu ra(n)ge keee rath athaak ||
lines.translation: They acquire beautiful horses and elephants, and ornate carriages of many kinds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਸਾਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis hee chit na paavahee bisariaa sabh saak ||
lines.translation: They think of nothing else, and they forget all their relatives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਪਾਕ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sirajanahaar bhulaaiaa vin naavai naapaak ||2||
lines.translation: They ignore their Creator; without the Name, they are impure. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੈਦਾ ਬਦ ਦੁਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: laidaa bad duaai too(n) maaiaa karahi ikat ||
lines.translation: Gathering the wealth of Maya, you earn an evil reputation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਪਤੀਆਇਦਾ ਸੋ ਸਣੁ ਤੁਝੈ ਅਨਿਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no too(n) pateeaaidaa so san tujhai anit ||
lines.translation: Those whom you work to please shall pass away along with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)kaar karahi aha(n)kaareeaa viaapiaa man kee mat ||
lines.translation: The egotistical are engrossed in egotism, ensnared by the intellect of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin prabh aap bhulaaiaa naa tis jaat na pat ||3||
lines.translation: One who is deceived by God Himself, has no position and no honor. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਇਕੋ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh milaaiaa iko sajan soi ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has led me to meet the One, my only Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣਸ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan kaa raakhaa ek hai kiaa maanas haumai roi ||
lines.translation: The One is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. Why should the proud cry out in ego?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har jan bhaavai so kare dar pher na paavai koi ||
lines.translation: As the servant of the Lord wills, so does the Lord act. At the Lord's Door, none of his requests are denied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੭੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak rataa ra(n)g har sabh jag mahi chaanan hoi ||4||1||71||
lines.translation: Nanak is attuned to the Love of the Lord, whose Light pervades the entire Universe. ||4||1||71||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸੁ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਘਣਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bilaas bahu ra(n)g ghanaa drisat bhool khuseeaa ||
lines.translation: With the mind caught up in playful pleasures, involved in all sorts of amusements and sights that stagger the eyes, people are led astray.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰ ਬਾਦਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਸੇ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chhatradhaar baadisaaheeaa vich sahase pareeaa ||1||
lines.translation: The emperors sitting on their thrones are consumed by anxiety. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaaee re sukh saadhasa(n)g paaiaa ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਬਿਧਾਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: likhiaa lekh tin purakh bidhaatai dukh sahasaa mit gaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If the Supreme Lord, the Architect of Destiny, writes such an order, then anguish and anxiety are erased. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਾ ਤੇਤੇ ਭਵਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jete thaan thana(n)taraa tete bhav aaiaa ||
lines.translation: There are so many places-I have wandered through them all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਵਡ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhan paatee vad bhoomeeaa meree meree kar pariaa ||2||
lines.translation: The masters of wealth and the great land-lords have fallen, crying out, "This is mine! This is mine!" ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅਫਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam chalaae nisa(n)g hoi varatai aphariaa ||
lines.translation: They issue their commands fearlessly, and act in pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਖਾਕੁ ਰਲਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko vasagat kar laion bin naavai khaak raliaa ||3||
lines.translation: They subdue all under their command, but without the Name, they are reduced to dust. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਸੇਵਕਾ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਦਰਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot tetees sevakaa sidh saadhik dar khariaa ||
lines.translation: Even those who are served by the 33 million angelic beings, at whose door the Siddhas and the Saadhus stand,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰੰਬਾਰੀ ਵਡ ਸਾਹਬੀ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਪਨੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੨॥
lines.transliteration: gira(n)baaree vad saahabee sabh naanak supan theeaa ||4||2||72||
lines.translation: who live in wondrous affluence and rule over mountains, oceans and vast dominions-O Nanak, in the end, all this vanishes like a dream! ||4||2||72||
